description: Reusable components, governed data and assets planned for the demo forms. All wording will be authored for the prototype; purposes below describe intent only.

brands.name: Example Super
brands.role: primary brand; its values live in product-data.csv

brands.name: Northwind Retirement
brands.role: second brand; its values are brand pack overrides

privacy.statement.purpose: How personal information on a form is collected, used and protected, and where the privacy policy lives.

tfn.notice.purpose: Why a tax file number is requested, that giving it is voluntary, and how it is used.

form.completion.instructions.purpose: How to fill in a form: pen colour, block letters, mandatory field marker.

return.instructions.purpose: How to send a completed form back and where to get help.
return.instructions.shape: heading and paragraph; contact facts come from data

declaration.transfer.purpose: Statements a member agrees to when asking to transfer a balance from another fund.

nomination.intro.purpose: Who the nomination form is for and that it goes to the employer, not the fund.

nomination.alternative.purpose: What to do when the member wants to nominate a different fund.

nomination.statement.purpose: The member's nomination of the fund shown in the fund details panel.

employer.records.instructions.purpose: What the employer completes and how long the form must be kept.

compliance.letter.body.purpose: Trustee confirmations that the fund can accept employer contributions, how to pay, and the help line.
compliance.letter.body.shape: salutation, lettered statements, two short sections

guide.online.tip.purpose: Details that can be changed online instead of by form.

guide.register.tip.purpose: Invitation to register for online access.

guide.section.current.purpose: What to enter in the current details section.

guide.section.contact.purpose: What to enter in the new contact details section.

guide.section.personal.purpose: What to enter when a name, birth date or gender changes, and the evidence needed.

guide.section.income.purpose: Who completes the bank and payment sections.

guide.section.checklist.purpose: Reminder to use the checklist, read the declaration and sign.

identity.name.change.evidence.purpose: Evidence required when personal details change.

income.account.explainer.purpose: What a retirement income account is and which sections to skip without one.

bank.details.conditions.purpose: Conditions on the bank account that payments can go to.

income.payment.conditions.purpose: Minimum payment rule and that changes apply from the next payment.

income.payment.footnotes.purpose: Footnotes explaining the minimum, maximum and blank-section behaviour.

identity.electronic.explainer.purpose: How electronic identity verification works and what it is used for.

identity.document.option.purpose: The certified-document alternative to electronic verification.

declaration.update.purpose: Member declaration for a change of details, with the under-age note and signing note.

declaration.representative.purpose: Declaration by a person signing on the member's behalf.

fund.name.purpose: Fund name in headings, panels and footers.

fund.spin.purpose: Legacy product identification number shown on the nomination form.

fund.address.purpose: Fund street address on one line.

trustee.name.purpose: Trustee legal name for issuer lines.

contact.phone.purpose: Help line, using numbers reserved for fiction.

contact.hours.purpose: Help line opening hours; shared by both brands to show a shared data change.

contact.website.purpose: Website on a reserved example domain.

contact.email.purpose: Forms mailbox on a reserved example domain.

letter.signatory.name.purpose: Fictional signatory of the compliance letter.

form.consolidate.code.purpose: Form code and version for the transfer form.

form.nomination.code.purpose: Form code and version for the nomination form.

form.update.code.purpose: Form code and version for the change of details form.

brand.logo.purpose: Abstract logo mark drawn for the prototype; the fund name beside it is live text from fund.name.

icon.online.purpose: Small marker for details that can be changed online.
